 Alexi Giannoulias wins reelection as Illinois Secretary of State, NBC News projects 
 Illinois Secretary of State Alexi Giannoulias will win reelection to his office, NBC News is projecting 
 By James Neveau • 
 Published 2 hours ago • 
 Updated 2 hours ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 You’re watching the NBC 5 Chicago News streaming channel, which plays local Chicago news 24 hours a day, seven days a week. You can find the “NBC 5 Chicago News” streaming channel on your phone or computer, and on Peacock, Samsung, Roku, Xumo or on our app, so you can watch our local news on your schedule.
 Illinois Secretary of State Alexi Giannoulias will be reelected to a second term in office, as NBC News projects he will defeat Diane Harris. 
 Giannoulias was first elected secretary of state in 2022 after Jesse White’s retirement after decades at the helm of the department.
 Stream NBC 5 for free, 24/7, wherever you are.
   WATCH HERE 
 During his oversight, the Secretary of State’s Office has undergone a transformation in terms of its offerings, prioritizing greater efficiency and convenience for motorists, especially when it comes to services made available over the internet.
 Giannoulias has also occasionally stepped into national political debates, supporting the state’s prohibition on book bans and on pushing for immigration agents to abide by state laws on area roadways, including with the use of proper license plates and other identification.

 He also oversaw the rollout of REAL ID-compliant identification cards, spearheading a supercenter in Chicago to help residents sign up for the cards ahead of a federal deadline in recent years.
 Now the big question for Giannoulias is what will follow in his political career, as he is currently running for mayor of Chicago. If he were to win that office, his replacement would be appointed by the governor, and would serve out the remainder of his term.
